title: HyperDrone: Simulation-to-Reality Transfer at Millions of Frames per Second
abstract: arXiv:2610.28950v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present HyperDrone, an extremely fast quadrotor simulator focused on high-performance batch rendering that is more than 20x faster than existing state-of-the-art batch quadrotor simulators. HyperDrone combines highly optimized multirotor dynamics with HyperLux, a new ray-tracing engine that supports Nvidia OptiX, Vulkan, Apple Metal and WebGPU backends that takes full advantage of modern ray-tracing hardware, capable of running both components entirely on the GPU. HyperLux renders RGB, depth, semantic/instance segmentation, surface normals and optical flow observations at configurable levels of fidelity, including reflections, realistic lighting, motion blur, anti-aliasing, and Physically Based Rendering (PBR). Even in the highest-fidelity settings, HyperLux achieves millions of Frames Per Second (FPS) on consumer-grade GPUs while rendering realistic 3D scenes. translated_title: HyperDrone：以每秒数百万帧实现仿真到现实的迁移
translated_abstract: 我们提出了HyperDrone，一个专注于高性能批量渲染的超快速四旋翼无人机模拟器，其速度比现有最先进的批量四旋翼模拟器快20倍以上。HyperDrone将高度优化的多旋翼动力学与HyperLux相结合，HyperLux是一种新型光线追踪引擎，支持Nvidia OptiX、Vulkan、Apple Metal和WebGPU后端，充分利用现代光线追踪硬件，并能将两个组件完全在GPU上运行。HyperLux能够以可配置的保真度级别渲染RGB、深度、语义/实例分割、表面法线和光流等观测信息，包括反射、逼真光照、运动模糊、抗锯齿以及基于物理的渲染（PBR）。即使在最高保真度设置下，HyperLux在消费级GPU上渲染逼真3D场景时仍能达到每秒数百万帧（FPS）的速度。我们通过训练基于视觉的偏航控制任务来展示HyperDrone的优势。
tldr: HyperDrone是一个超高速四旋翼无人机模拟器，通过结合优化的多旋翼动力学与新型光线追踪引擎HyperLux，比现有最先进模拟器快20倍以上，并能在消费级GPU上以每秒数百万帧的速度渲染高保真逼真图像，从而实现高效的仿真到现实迁移。
en_tdlr: HyperDrone is an ultra-fast quadrotor simulator that combines optimized multirotor dynamics with the HyperLux ray-tracing engine, achieving over 20x speedup over state-of-the-art batch simulators and rendering photorealistic 3D scenes at millions of FPS on consumer-grade GPUs for efficient sim-to-real transfer.
